Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by 
Y1 in the title block or during any stoppage.

Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses).
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place.
